touches.subject: Models for the factory
touches.body:
Your AI Factory expansion is public: Kamloops, two new Vancouver sites, a target of 60,000 GPUs by 2032. The open question for every sovereign factory is the model layer. What runs on the racks, privately, for customers who cannot send data out?

That is the layer we build. North and the Command family already run on sovereign Canadian infrastructure today: fully private, nothing leaves the environment. Your factory. Your customers' data. Our models, running inside both.

Worth a 20-minute call on what a model-layer partnership could look like for the expansion sites?

touches.subject: What fills sovereign capacity
touches.body:
One thought since my first note. GPU capacity sells to customers who already know what they will run on it. The regulated buyers filling sovereign capacity, banks, government, and health among them, need models they are allowed to deploy: private, in-country, strong at retrieval on their own data.

Offer that layer with the racks and capacity becomes an AI service. That is the partnership we want to explore. Open to a short call with your enterprise product team?
